llm.summary: The skill performs an Etsy category lookup, but it can send queries plus LinkFox API key and session metadata to a configurable remote gateway and persist full responses locally.

dimensions.detail: The Etsy category lookup purpose is coherent, but the headline/frontmatter emphasizes a locally synced category library while the script calls a LinkFox remote gateway with the user's query and API key.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger text is broad and instructs activation even when the tool name is not mentioned, which can cause remote lookup behavior for general Etsy category mentions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a small skill package with SKILL.md, one reference document, and one Python script; it does not install packages or set up background services.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network access and a LinkFox API key are purpose-aligned, but the destination can be overridden by an environment variable and the script also forwards SESSION_ID, MODE_ID, and APP_NAME headers.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: There is no privilege escalation or autorun persistence, but the script writes cached responses, full response files, and session metadata under linkfox directories with fallback locations including the home directory and temp directory.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with Etsy category search terms, a LinkFox API key, and session metadata being sent to LinkFox or to any gateway configured in the environment. Review or lock down LINKFOX_TOOL_GATEWAY, and periodically clear the local linkfox cache/session output if retained API responses are not needed.
llm.findings:
[TT3] unexpected: A remote API call is expected for a LinkFox-backed lookup, but forwarding the API key and session metadata to an environment-overridable gateway is broader than necessary and merits review.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The artifact has mixed disclosure: the reference document names the remote LinkFox gateway, while the skill description implies locally synced category lookup, creating a real expectation mismatch.
[SDI-1] expected: Caching and saving results can support debugging and large responses, but full-response persistence is broader than a simple category ID lookup and should be understood before use.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The activation language is broader than explicit category-ID lookup intent and could trigger the skill for general Etsy category questions.
